name: Exp_Directed_Movement_Candle
summary: This EA trades based on the Directed_Movement_Candle custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothed RSI approach to determine directional momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signal processing and supports both trade opening and closing based on indicator signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Directed_Movement_Candle自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用双重平滑RSI方法来确定方向性动量。当指标发出看涨动量信号（颜色值为2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（颜色值为0）时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号处理，同时支持基于指标信号的开仓和平仓操作。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Directed_Movement_Candle指标，该指标内部使用RSI经过两层不同平滑算法处理后的结果来判断市场方向性动量。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值为2（看涨）且前一根K线值小于2时开多仓；当当前值为0（看跌）且前一根K线值大于0时开空仓。出场条件包括：当指标信号反转时主动平仓（多转空时平多仓，空转多时平空仓），以及固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的动态手数模式。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举选择手数计算方式，默认0.1的保证金比例相对保守。策略允许用户独立控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓开关，提供了灵活的交易方向配置。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Directed_Movement_Candle indicator, which internally uses RSI processed through two different smoothing algorithms to determine directional market momentum. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when indicator buffer 4's current value is 2 (bullish) and the previous bar's value is less than 2; open a sell position when the current value is 0 (bearish) and the previous bar's value is greater than 0. Exit conditions include: active position closing when the indicator signal reverses (close buy when signal turns bearish, close sell when signal turns bullish), plus fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lots or dynamic lot sizing based on margin percentage. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration to select lot calculation method, with a default 0.1 margin ratio being relatively conservative. The strategy allows users to independently control buy and sell opening and closing switches, providing flexible trading direction configuration.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小比例
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio parameter, controls position sizing

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（固定手数或基于保证金）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Buy open signal mode: dot signal/direction signal/disabled

parameters.name: SellPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Sell open signal mode: dot signal/direction signal/disabled

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线编号
parameters.description_en: Bar index used to retrieve trading signal

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: RSI平滑模式选择（第一种或第二种）
parameters.description_en: RSI smoothing mode selection (first or second)

pros: 双平滑RSI指标设计减少了虚假信号，双重过滤提高了信号可靠性
开仓和平仓开关独立可配，允许只做单向交易或仅使用信号平仓
使用新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少了过度交易风险
止损和止盈均有设置，提供了基本的风险控制框架
指标加载失败时有错误检查和处理，初始化较为健壮
pros_en: Dual-smoothed RSI indicator design reduces false signals, double filtering improves signal reliability
Independent configurable switches for opening and closing allow directional-only trading or signal-based closing only
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated position opening within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Both stop loss and take profit are set, providing a basic risk control framework
Error checking and handling when indicator fails to load, relatively robust initialization
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值过大，在大多数品种上风险极高
缺乏点差过滤，在H4周期虽然影响较小但在流动性差时仍可能被滑点影响
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
HighLevel/MiddleLevel/LowLevel参数在代码中声明但未在交易逻辑中使用，属于无效参数
依赖外部自定义指标Directed_Movement_Candle，若指标未安装则EA无法运行且错误提示不够明确
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, posing extreme risk on most instruments
No spread filter, though less impactful on H4, slippage can still affect trades during low liquidity
No position check logic, may repeatedly open positions in the same direction when already holding
HighLevel/MiddleLevel/LowLevel parameters are declared but unused in trading logic, making them dead parameters
Depends on external custom indicator Directed_Movement_Candle, EA cannot run if indicator is not installed and error messaging is insufficient
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同品种的波动特性
删除HighLevel/MiddleLevel/LowLevel等未使用的参数，或将其纳入实际交易逻辑中
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid repeated opening in the same direction which leads to overexposure
Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different instruments' volatility characteristics
Remove unused parameters like HighLevel/MiddleLevel/LowLevel, or integrate them into actual trading logic
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to improve risk control capability

risk_points: 止损1000点固定值过大，在波动剧烈品种上可能造成巨额亏损
缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，仓位过度集中
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或版本不匹配会导致EA无法正常交易
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss is excessively large and may cause significant losses on volatile instruments
Lack of position check may lead to repeated same-direction openings and over-concentrated exposure
Dependency on external custom indicator means missing or mismatched indicator files will prevent EA from trading properly
